holm.note: Holm is computed against the DECLARED family size, not the number of legs that happened to run. A leg that could not run does not make the correction cheaper for the ones that did.
holm.c_v1_is_computed_elsewhere: `disposition_overhang_conditioner_v1` is this family's fourth declared primary and is read by `scripts/night_c_falsifiers.C_v1`. It is NAMED here without a p-value rather than dropped, because Holm over three p-values in a family that declared four is a different correction and a reader has to see which happened. `C_v1`'s own receipt reads this one and prints the complete four-leg block.
